tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway (lane 39b), continuing an unreleased diff. Work entirely inside your current working directory; never modify anything outside CWD - in particular never touch /home/ankit114/repos/gw-diag-snap or /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW39. No network, no git commits, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys. CONTEXT: Lane 39 (already built, uncommitted, verified) added relative-offset date parsing to resolve_relative_date in container/bland_gateway.py. A live measurement against the v104 pathway then found a second parser gap: the pathway's offered-date searches pin the request 'from'/'to' fields to the slot variable value '08/06/2026 10:30 am' - a date WITH a trailing clock time - and the gateway returns HTTP 409 because the from/to date parser cannot handle the time suffix (the same 409 class that bare '2 weeks' used to produce). TASK: (1) Copy the LANE-39 WORK (not the pristine repo) into CWD: cp -r /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW39/gw-relative-date-fix/gw ./gw and cp /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW39/gw-relative-date-fix/proof_parse.py . - this preserves the lane-39 relative-offset changes; build on top of them. (2) Extend the from/to date resolution so a date string carrying a trailing clock time - forms like '08/06/2026 10:30 am', '8/6/2026 4:15 pm', and the same with AM/PM capitalization - resolves to the date part exactly as the bare date would. Strip the time suffix before existing parsing rather than duplicating date logic; keep the diff minimal and additive; every currently-passing phrase must keep its behavior. (3) Add unit tests beside the lane-39 tests covering '08/06/2026 10:30 am' and '8/6/2026 4:15 PM' resolving to their date parts, plus one regression case each for a bare explicit date, a weekday, and '2 weeks from today', using the frozen-today pattern the lane-39 test used. Run the FULL suite in ./gw; all green. (4) Extend ./proof_parse.py so its built-in list also includes '08/06/2026 10:30 am' printing 'PHRASE=08/06/2026 10:30 am DATE=2026-08-06'. (5) Update DEBUG-GW.md (copy it from the lane-39 task dir first): append a lane-39b section with the 409 evidence, the parser location, the change, and test output tail; keep the existing note that deploy is separately gated. Leave all changes uncommitted in ./gw.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_parse.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof_parse crashed'; tail -5 proof.out; exit 1; }; grep -q 'PHRASE=08/06/2026 10:30 am DATE=2026-08-06' proof.out || { echo 'FAIL: datetime string did not resolve to its date part'; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; exp=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print((datetime.date.today()+datetime.timedelta(days=14)).isoformat())"); grep -q "PHRASE=2 weeks from today DATE=$exp" proof.out || { echo 'FAIL: lane-39 relative-offset behavior regressed'; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; cd gw && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; echo "$summary" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+ passed' || { echo "FAIL: pytest summary not clean: $summary"; exit 1; }; grep -qi '409' DEBUG-GW.md || { echo 'FAIL: DEBUG-GW.md lacks the 409 evidence section'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: datetime tolerance proven on top of lane-39 - $summary"
tasks.verified: The gateway resolves slot-pinned datetime strings to their date part on top of the lane-39 relative-offset fix, proven by executing the parser and the full suite, with the combined diff left uncommitted for the separately gated deploy.
